```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Information Management

  As an admin, I want to update doctor, lab, and chemist information in the system
  As a patient, I want to update my personal details and create future appointments

Scenario Outline: Updating Information and Appointments
  Given I am an admin with access to the system
  And I am a patient with access to my appointment file
  When I update doctor information
    Then the doctor's profile should be updated
  When I update lab information
    Then the lab's profile should be updated
  When I update chemist information
    Then the chemist's profile should be updated
  When I update my personal details
    Then my personal details should be updated
  When I create an appointment
    Then the appointment should be created and visible in my appointment file

Examples:
  | Doctor's Name | Lab Name | Chemist Name | Personal Details | Appointment Date |
  | John Doe      | Lab A    | Chemist X     | Jane Smith       | 2023-05-15       |
  | Jane Doe      | Lab B    | Chemist Y     | John Smith       | 2023-06-15       |
  | Invalid Doctor | Lab C    | Chemist Z     | Invalid Details  | Invalid Date     |
  | Doctor's Name | Invalid Lab | Chemist Y     | Personal Details  | Appointment Date |
  | Doctor's Name | Lab A    | Invalid Chemist | Personal Details  | Appointment Date |
  | Doctor's Name | Lab A    | Chemist Y     | Invalid Details  | 2023-05-15       |
  | Doctor's Name | Lab A    | Chemist Y     | Personal Details  | Invalid Date     |

Scenario Outline: Verifying Updated Information
  Given I am an admin with access to the system
  And I have updated doctor information
  When I verify the updated information
    Then the updated doctor's profile should match the input

Examples:
  | Doctor's Name | Lab Name | Chemist Name | Personal Details | Appointment Date |
  | John Doe      | Lab A    | Chemist X     | Jane Smith       | 2023-05-15       |
  | Invalid Doctor | Lab C    | Chemist Z     | Invalid Details  | Invalid Date     |

Scenario Outline: Creating and Viewing Appointments
  Given I am a patient with access to my appointment file
  When I create an appointment
    Then the appointment should be created and visible in my appointment file

Examples:
  | Appointment Date |
  | 2023-05-15       |
  | 2023-06-15       |
  | Invalid Appointment Date |
